thread:
Alex: Morning handoff — I'm taking off in ~30. What I did: triaged the embed-service latency spike, added a temporary rate-limit rule on embedding requests from bulk ingestion jobs, and rolled back the canary for quant-optimizer v2.1 -> v2.0. Blockers: KV cache eviction rate is still high for eu-west shards, seeing ~0.5% 5xx on /v1/embeddings (internal). Today / next steps: run a full eviction analysis, coordinate with infra to increase memory on embed-eu-03, review Jen's batching PR, and follow up with model-ops on a safer quant rollout plan. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Thanks Alex. Quick Q — can you paste a sample failed request id and which host it hit? Also are there any customer-facing incidents we should page for? :eyes:

Alex: No active customer-facing incidents; only internal test failures earlier that were mitigated. Sample failed req: `req_id=7f3d-embed-119`, host `embed-eu-03`. Minimal log snippet: ```ERROR embed-service: request=7f3d-embed-119 status=503 kv_eviction=true mem_available=1.2Gi host=embed-eu-03``` Retrieval command: `kubectl logs -l app=embed -n prod --tail=200 | grep 7f3d`

Marco: On infra side I can bump the pod memory request on embed-eu-03 to 48Gi as an immediate mitigation and restart the node to force cache warmup. Scheduling restart at 10:15 UTC, expect ~6m disruption for that pod. Will post when complete.

DeployBot: Canary rollback executed: quant-optimizer v2.1 -> v2.0 completed by @Alex at 2350006701. No deploy errors. :robot_face:

Jen: FYI I left feedback on PR #3427 about batching defaults — aligns with the temp rate-limiter you applied. Suggestion: set `batch_max_tokens: 1024` for embeddings to reduce small-request overhead. Also added a note to the PR about adding a canary metric for quantized model errors.

Alex: Good call, Jen — will review PR after handoff. Eviction analysis command I ran locally: `scripts/eviction-check.sh embed eu-west` (outputs top keys and eviction rates). Alert thresholds: current alert fires at >0.3% 5xx over 5m; escalate to SRE if >1% sustained for 5m. Leaving runbook note: /playbooks/embeddings-evictions (added a short checklist).

Priya: I'll take primary monitoring until Marco's restart completes, will watch the 5xx and KV evictions dashboards. Ping me @Priya if the 5xx goes over 0.5% so I can start mitigation steps.

Marco: Restart started at 10:15 UTC, rolling pod replacement in progress. ETA ~7m.

Alex: Thanks all — handoff complete, I'm out at 09:00 UTC. Priya primary, Marco secondary. If anything customer-facing pops up, escalate through the usual page path and tag @oncall-escalation. Leaving a quick checklist in the thread and the runbook. :coffee:

Priya: Got it, taking over. Will update here after restart and after a 10m observation window.
